desc:
Draw roads, connect colorful houses to their workplaces, and keep a growing city moving! 🚗

Cross Traffic is a relaxing road-building puzzle. Every house sends cars to the businesses of its color. Lay roads, then use bridges, tunnels, roundabouts, traffic lights and motorways to beat the jams before your city gridlocks.

🌆 12 real cities, from Los Angeles to Paris, Sydney and Cairo
🚀 Map packs: the Moon, Mars and Pluto, or Hawaii, Diego Garcia and Mauritius
🏆 Classic, Expert, Endless and Creative modes, city challenges, daily and weekly cities
🚚 A garage of vehicles: compact, pickup, box truck and sports car, with stripes, flames and chrome
🎨 City themes: Blueprint, Toy town, Neon night and Winter
🌧️ Day and night, rain, photo mode, and follow any car
🎧 Calm music that only turns tense when your city is in trouble, plus sound packs
📱 Phone, tablet, PC and console, 15 languages, color-blind mode

How big can your city grow?
